text:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A - leadership asked for month-level clarity on the Lighthouse deliverables (API knobs, Console traffic UX, Optimize cost-rec recommendations) so PMs and partners can lock calendars.

sanjay: short version: aiming for a phased rollout across Q3/Q4. we can call out target months and which ones are contingencies vs commitments.

anna: confirming scope: API = latency and routing knobs + graceful fallback, Console = traffic-shaping UI + rollout controls, Optimize = automated cost recs + eval harness. any additions?

maria: that matches what was presented. also need Dedicated canary window length so infra can reserve GPUs.

kevin: SDK note: streaming SDK changes (client-side) land ahead of API knobs; SDK team needs a 3-4 week freeze after release for integrations.

oliver: engineering: kernel-routing patch is the main blocker. if it lands by mid-Aug, API beta stays Aug; if delayed, everything slips ~4 weeks. current risk: medium.

anna: tentative timeline - API knobs beta: Aug (target); Console traffic-shaping beta: Sep; Optimize v1 (cost-recs + evals): Oct; Dedicated canary start: Nov 1.

maria: which dates are hard commitments? customers will push if vague.

sanjay: firm commitment: Dedicated canary start = Nov 1. API/Console/Optimize months are targets with explicit fallback plan if kernel patch slips.

anna: action: i'll publish a 1-page timeline with gating criteria and fallback offsets by EOW. will include canary duration (default 2 weeks) and success metrics.

kevin: SDK freeze window: Aug 15 -> Sep 12. please avoid interface changes in that interval.

oliver: ops ask: we need VIP list of customers for the canary. CS/partnerships to propose by Oct 10.

maria: noted - @cs and @partners, please coordinate. also flag any legal/regulatory customers early.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: lighthouse-roadmap-onepager -> /eng-docs/lighthouse/onepager (created by anna)

anna: keeping thread open for follow-ups. if anyone needs a sync on dates, DM me and i'll schedule a 30m sync. :thumbsup:
